automation_security_scan.label: Security scan
automation_security_scan.help: Whether a security scan starts by itself, only on request, or never.

security_gate.label: Security gate
security_gate.help: Off ignores scans; advisory shows them; required blocks merge readiness until no blocking finding is open.

security_blocking_severity.label: Blocking severity
security_blocking_severity.help: Findings at or above this severity block a required gate.

security_model.label: Scan model
security_model.help: The model the scanner uses. There is no default; a scan will not start without one.

security_budget_mode.label: Scan budget mode
security_budget_mode.help: Unset blocks scans. Capped uses the amount below; unlimited needs a deliberate choice.

security_budget_usd.label: Scan budget (USD)
security_budget_usd.help: The most one scan may spend when the mode is capped.

security_max_turns.label: Scan turn limit
security_max_turns.help: The most agent turns one scan may take.

security_timeout_secs.label: Scan time limit (seconds)
security_timeout_secs.help: A scan that runs longer is stopped and never counts as a pass.

codegraph_auto_index.label: Automatic code index
codegraph_auto_index.help: Index the base commit of a run before coding or review.

codegraph_impact_max_bytes.label: Impact section size
codegraph_impact_max_bytes.help: The most bytes of the code impact section in a role packet.

codegraph_keep_indexes_per_repo.label: Indexes kept per repository
codegraph_keep_indexes_per_repo.help: Older indexes of a repository are offered for removal.

skills_max_bytes_per_role.label: Skill guidance size
skills_max_bytes_per_role.help: The most bytes of skill guidance added to a role brief.

extensions_sandbox.label: Extension sandbox
extensions_sandbox.help: Enforce refuses an extension when the sandbox cannot be applied; best effort runs it anyway.
